effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] If your opponent has 5 or fewer cards in their hand, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and trash 1 card in your hand. If your opponent has 7 or more cards in their hand, your opponent trashes 1 card in their hand.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] While your opponent has 6 or fewer cards in their hand, this Digimon gets +1000 DP.
